## Details

<a id="command_table"></a>
### [`command_table`](../../../../src/data/menu_tables.asm#L6) `$0D71`

*data*

Address of the routine of each command 0-$11: 0 cmd_none, 1 Draw, 2 Line, 3 Lines, 4 Frame, 5 Circle, 6 Rays, 7 Box, 8 Disc, 9 Fill, $0a Xcolor, $0b Copy, $0c Zoom, $0d Mirror, $0e Swap, $0f Storage, $10 Oops, $11 Erase. run_command jumps through it.

- **Read by:** [`menu`](../menu/menu.md#menu)

<a id="command_table_hi"></a>
### [`command_table_hi`](../../../../src/data/menu_tables.asm#L8) `$0D72-$0D94`

*data*

- **Read by:** [`menu`](../menu/menu.md#menu)

<a id="flash_cell_table"></a>
### [`flash_cell_table`](../../../../src/data/menu_tables.asm#L16) `$0D95`

*data*

Colour RAM address of the flash cell of each index 0-$13: the commands 1-$0a, $12 Erase ($da28), $13 Mirror ($d848). 0 = no cell (0, $0b-$11).

- **Read by:** [`SETFLASH`](../menu/flash.md#SETFLASH), [`ONLSTFX1`](../menu/flash.md#ONLSTFX1)

<a id="flash_cell_table_hi"></a>
### [`flash_cell_table_hi`](../../../../src/data/menu_tables.asm#L18) `$0D96-$0DBC`

*data*

- **Read by:** [`SETFLASH`](../menu/flash.md#SETFLASH), [`ONLSTFX1`](../menu/flash.md#ONLSTFX1)

<a id="brush_table"></a>
### [`brush_table`](../../../../src/data/menu_tables.asm#L26) `$0DBD`

*data*

Address of the shape data of each of the 8 brushes, at the even indexes 0-$0e (brush_index).

- **Read by:** [`cmd_zoom`](../menu/menu.md#cmd_zoom)
